source: Lets start with a simple baseplate where the player is a physics based vehicle, for now no model but I want to have the player to be spawned into a floating part resembling the sizes of a scooter

image_prompt.text: A floating part roughly the size of a scooter hovering above the baseplate, where the player enters the world
A plain flat baseplate with no props, terrain or dressing on it

layout_placement.text: The player spawns into the floating scooter-sized part rather than onto the ground

notes: No preset was offered: Explorable Place, Social Space and Open Sandbox all add landmarks, paths or pickups, and the prompt explicitly wants nothing but a baseplate for now.
All five no-genre axes stay at their defaults, so this routes P0.
This is a first build step rather than a finished concept - the user says lets start with, so expect the shape to change on the next turn.
